author: minmaxxxer
description:
NBA 2026-27 odds and results, updated weekly
	

Every game of the 2026-27 NBA season played so far — 146 regular-season games (updated every Monday; last update 9 November 2026) — with the betting market's consensus opening and closing lines (spread, total, moneyline win probability) and
every bet already graded: against the spread (ATS), over/under and moneyline. One row per game, ready for pandas, R, SQL
or a spreadsheet.
Built for backtesting, closing line value (CLV) research… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/minmaxxxer/nba-odds-2026-27.
